claim_text: A lithium-ion secondary battery comprising: a cathode comprising lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide; an anode comprising silicon-graphite composite nanoparticles; and a non-aqueous liquid electrolyte comprising fluoroethylene carbonate additive.
expected_limitations: cathode comprising lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide
anode comprising silicon-graphite composite nanoparticles
non-aqueous liquid electrolyte comprising fluoroethylene carbonate additive

claim_text: A solid-state composite electrolyte membrane for an all-solid-state lithium battery comprising: an inorganic sulfide-based solid electrolyte represented by Li6PS5Cl argyrodite; and a fluorinated copolymer binder comprising vinylidene fluoride and hexafluoropropylene units.
expected_limitations: inorganic sulfide-based solid electrolyte represented by Li6PS5Cl argyrodite
fluorinated copolymer binder comprising vinylidene fluoride and hexafluoropropylene units

claim_text: A neuromorphic computing device comprising: a crossbar array comprising a plurality of analog resistive random-access memory (ReRAM) cells at wordline-bitline intersections; a digital-to-analog converter array; and current-sensing analog-to-digital converters measuring column summation currents.
expected_limitations: crossbar array of analog resistive random-access memory (ReRAM) cells
digital-to-analog converter array
current-sensing analog-to-digital converters measuring column summation currents

claim_text: A hardware accelerator for transformer neural networks comprising: a token sparsity engine configured to calculate token significance scores and prune tokens; a self-attention compute unit; and an on-chip SRAM buffer storing intermediate KV-cache states.
expected_limitations: token sparsity engine calculating significance scores and pruning tokens
self-attention compute unit
on-chip SRAM buffer storing KV-cache

claim_text: A semiconductor device comprising: a substrate; a vertical stack of horizontal silicon nanosheet channels; a high-k metal gate electrode wrapping around the nanosheet channels; source/drain epitaxial regions; and low-k inner dielectric spacers between the gate electrode and the source/drain regions.
expected_limitations: vertical stack of horizontal silicon nanosheet channels
high-k metal gate electrode wrapping around channels
low-k inner dielectric spacers between gate and source/drain regions

claim_text: A pharmaceutical composition comprising lipid nanoparticles encapsulating messenger RNA, comprising an ionizable amino lipid with biodegradable ester linkages, a neutral helper phospholipid DSPC, cholesterol, and a PEGylated lipid conjugate.
expected_limitations: lipid nanoparticles encapsulating messenger RNA
ionizable amino lipid with biodegradable ester linkages
neutral helper phospholipid DSPC and cholesterol and PEGylated lipid

claim_text: A computer-implemented method for achieving consensus in a distributed network comprising: receiving a block proposal containing cryptographic transactions; computing a verifiable random function (VRF) proof using a private key and an epoch seed; and generating a Boneh-Lynn-Shacham (BLS) threshold signature share.
expected_limitations: verifiable random function (VRF) proof using private key and epoch seed
Boneh-Lynn-Shacham (BLS) threshold signature share
validating state transition function

claim_text: A superconducting quantum computing device comprising: a cryogenic substrate; a Josephson tunnel junction; a capacitive shunt electrode; and a superinductor element comprising a thin film of granular aluminum having high kinetic inductance.
expected_limitations: small-area Josephson tunnel junction and capacitive shunt electrode
superinductor element comprising thin film of granular aluminum
fluxonium qubit loop operating at cryogenic temperatures

claim_text: A monolithic tandem photovoltaic cell comprising: a bottom crystalline silicon subcell; an intermediate recombination layer; a top perovskite subcell comprising a self-assembled monolayer of carbazole-phosphonic acid; a metal halide perovskite absorber layer; and an electron-selective C60 layer.
expected_limitations: bottom crystalline silicon subcell
intermediate recombination layer
self-assembled monolayer of carbazole-phosphonic acid hole transport layer
metal halide perovskite absorber layer

claim_text: A solid-state LiDAR sensor system comprising: a tunable laser source configured to generate a frequency-modulated continuous-wave (FMCW) optical beam; a silicon photonics optical phased array (OPA) chip; an optical receive aperture; and a balanced photodetector extracting simultaneous range and Doppler radial velocity.
expected_limitations: tunable laser source generating frequency-modulated continuous-wave (FMCW) beam
silicon photonics optical phased array (OPA) chip steering beam without moving parts
balanced photodetector extracting simultaneous range and Doppler radial velocity
